comment: P10-3 (ADR-020 amendment): the union base of every generated segment struct whose base is not the canonical v2.5.1. The codegen takes a listed segment's base from here, never from the earliest definer, so a released struct's accessor names and types cannot move when an earlier version is added. Derived from the v3.13.0 generated headers; a new segment's base is added in the commit that introduces it (StructBasePinTests).
